name: mangrove-agent
description: Mangrove agent workflows and native Codex wallet-secret hooks. Connect the local MCP service separately with scripts/client_session.py; its local API credential is distinct from the upstream MangroveAI key.

interface.longDescription: Mangrove agent workflows and native Codex wallet-secret checks. Hooks require review and trust. Configure the local MCP service separately with scripts/client_session.py using the local API_KEYS credential; this package requests no credential and does not register an MCP connection.
